description: Full E2E blueprint for the Journey Builder feature. Steps 1-12 validate the current implementation (launch, welcome/setup flow, step editing with navigation, Title Sentence conversion, export, action builder with 34 tools, live JSON preview with copy-to-clipboard, event autocomplete, command picker, assert type builder, real-time canvas sync, full 3-file export, open existing journey). Step 13 is a development target: preview run.

improvements.title: Attach vault notes to journey steps
improvements.description: Allow attaching vault notes to the journey or individual steps, either via autosuggest (file picker) or by adding them like goals in the session view (Enter to add, x to remove). Notes give context to what each step tests or references.

improvements.title: Build-only option in interactive session view
improvements.description: Added 'd) Build only' to the session view menu. Quick-builds and deploys to the test vault without re-running tests, then returns to the same session view.

improvements.title: Title Sentence to event name conversion
improvements.description: Start and end event inputs auto-convert Title Sentence input (e.g. 'Session Started') to dot-notation (session.started) with a live preview below the input. Users can type natural names or raw dot-notation — both work seamlessly.
